$comment: The pools on the mainnet forknet. Add yours by opening a PR that appends one object to "pools". Every field marked required in README.md must be present, and "chain" must read "mainnet". coinbase_tag is the important one: it is the only thing that lets an explorer attribute a mined block to you. This file is hand-edited; the pools-v2.json beside it is generated from it by tools/build.py, so run that script and commit its output in the same PR.

pools.name: FreeBank
pools.payout: Solo self-mining by the FreeBank sidechain operator (BIP300 slot 130). The coinbase pays the operator address directly; no public hashpower is solicited.

pools.name: eCPool.tech
pools.payout: The stratum username is your address (bc1q or bc1p); the coinbase pays every miner in the PPLNS window directly, so the pool never holds funds. Port 3336 is solo mode, 3335 and 3337 are for rented hashrate.

pools.name: Pow.re
pools.payout: Pow.re's own fleet only, no outside hashrate. Solo mode: each block's coinbase pays Pow.re's address directly.

pools.name: avonpool
pools.payout: The stratum username is your Thunder address (optionally .rig_label); a Bitcoin address is rejected at authorize. Each block is split across the last N shares before it, less the 0.01% operator fee, and balances settle over the Thunder sidechain (#9) once the block has 100 confirmations. Port 3334 is from difficulty 1 for individual miners; 3335 (Braiins, from difficulty 1,048,576) and 3336 (NiceHash, from difficulty 2,000,000) are for rented or aggregated hashrate.

pools.name: bip300.xyz
pools.payout: The stratum username is your BTC address (optionally .rig_label); solo mode pays the finder's address directly in that block's coinbase, minus the 0.1% operator fee. Port 3334 is from difficulty 1 for individual miners; 3335 (Braiins, from difficulty 1,048,576) and 3336 (NiceHash, from difficulty 2,000,000) are for rented or aggregated hashrate.

pools.name: supapool
pools.payout: The stratum username is your ECX address (optionally .worker); solo mode pays the finder's address directly in that block's coinbase, minus the 1% operator fee, on port 3383 (TCP) or 3384 (TLS).

pools.name: eCashPool.io
pools.payout: PPS Classic with 0% fees. Use a Thunder sidechain (#9) address as the Stratum username, optionally followed by .rig_label. Accepted shares earn Thunder credits, paid to miners from the funded pool's Thunder payout reserve.

pools.name: MergedHash
pools.payout: The stratum username is your bc1 address (optionally .worker); PPLNS on port 3338 pays recent sharers directly in each block's coinbase and solo on port 3335 pays the finder directly, minus the 1% fee, with BMM sidechain fees included in the miners' reward.

pools.name: SegPool ECX
pools.payout: Solo: the stratum username is your ECX address plus a rig name (bc1q, 1 or 3 address, e.g. ADDRESS.rig1, any password). Each block's coinbase pays the finder 98% and the pool 2% directly, so the pool never holds funds.

pools.name: BCM EU · ECX SOLO
pools.payout: Use an ECX mainnet receiving address with an optional .worker suffix as the Stratum username; password x. SOLO pays the finding address directly in the block coinbase, less the 1% pool fee. High-difficulty rental endpoint: eu.bcmpool.online:4340.

pools.name: BCM EU · ECX PPLNS
pools.payout: Use an ECX mainnet receiving address with an optional .worker suffix as the Stratum username; password x. PPLNS pays eligible recent miners directly through the block coinbase, less the 1% pool fee. High-difficulty rental endpoint: eu.bcmpool.online:4342.
